title: How Figma’s PMs actually use AI every day | Ezra Mechaber (PM, Figma)
text: How Figma’s PMs actually use AI every day | Ezra Mechaber (PM, Figma) Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 4 How Figma’s PMs actually use AI every day | Ezra Mechaber (PM, Figma) 🎙️ Figma growth PM Ezra Mechaber demos PM OS, a 31-skill repo used by 60+ PMs, and AutoXP, an agent that runs growth experiments with one human checkpoint Claire Vo Nov 02, 2026 4 Share Ezra Mechaber is a growth product manager at Figma whose goal is to be “lazy in the right places.” When he joined Figma, he found almost no one outside engineering using AI to get real work done, so he and a couple of fellow PMs turned his personal Claude Code setup into PM OS, a shared repo of 31 skills that every PM at Figma now uses. In this episode, Ezra walks me through his favorite skills, how he bug bashes with Codex, AutoXP—an automated growth PM that found a huge win on its very first experiment—and a real-time writing assistant he built with Jev. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts What you’ll learn: Why PM OS is a repo, not a product The skill Ezra runs six times a day to tame Slack How one repo keeps 60 to 70 PMs in sync Why his bug-bash agent catches things he never would How AutoXP runs experiments with one human checkpoint Why Jev took over every meeting he was in for two weeks What to do when you want to yell at
